using LinearAlgebra
using Plots
using Polynomials
default(linewidth=4, legendfontsize=12)

function vander(x, k=nothing)
    if isnothing(k)
        k = length(x)
    end
    m = length(x)
    V = ones(m, k)
    for j in 2:k
        V[:, j] = V[:, j-1] .* x
    end
    V
end

function gram_schmidt_naive(A)
    m, n = size(A)
    Q = zeros(m, n)
    R = zeros(n, n)
    for j in 1:n
        v = A[:,j]
        for k in 1:j-1
            r = Q[:,k]' * v
            v -= Q[:,k] * r
            R[k,j] = r
        end
        R[j,j] = norm(v)
        Q[:,j] = v / R[j,j]
    end
    Q, R
end

function gram_schmidt_classical(A)
    m, n = size(A)
    Q = zeros(m, n)
    R = zeros(n, n)
    for j in 1:n
        v = A[:,j]
        R[1:j-1,j] = Q[:,1:j-1]' * v
        v -= Q[:,1:j-1] * R[1:j-1,j]
        R[j,j] = norm(v)
        Q[:,j] = v / R[j,j]
    end
    Q, R
end

function gram_schmidt_modified(A)
    m, n = size(A)
    Q = copy(A)
    R = zeros(n, n)
    for j in 1:n
        R[j,j] = norm(Q[:,j])
        Q[:,j] /= R[j,j]
        R[j,j+1:end] = Q[:,j]'*Q[:,j+1:end]
        Q[:,j+1:end] -= Q[:,j]*R[j,j+1:end]'
    end
    Q, R
end
